Check an Envelope statement

Someone shared figures from their private Envelope balance. This page checks each one against Solana, in your browser.

Each amount comes with a zero-knowledge proof that the encrypted amount stored on Solana, under the wallet's own key, is exactly that number. The page reads the encrypted values from the chain itself, so a statement can't make up a figure, a transfer or a token.

A statement shows only what its owner chose to include. It can't reveal anything else, and nothing here gives access to the account. Checking reads public data from a Solana RPC node, which sees which accounts are looked up.
